source_signature.notes: Batch 4J skill 2/5. Owns determination of truss MEMBER forces by isolating one joint at a time: each joint is a concurrent force system with exactly two independent equations, SigmaFx = 0 and SigmaFy = 0, so at most two unknown member forces can be resolved at any one joint. Owns the START-JOINT constraint and the propagation that follows - begin at a joint with at most two unknowns, and each solved joint reduces the unknown count at adjacent joints. Boundary: truss_support_reactions (signed, skill 1 of this batch) determines the external reactions and states that this skill takes them as input; the artifact carries the complement - Ax, Ay and Cy are GIVEN and are not re-derived, and this skill computes member forces only. simple_truss_modeling (signed) supplies the idealisation of pin joints, two-force members and loads at joints, cited not re-derived; two-force members are why each member force acts along the member axis. particle_fbd_2d and solve_particle_equil_2d (signed) are the concurrent-equilibrium analogue - a joint IS a particle - cited not re-taught. method_of_sections (batch sibling, position 3) obtains a few member forces by cutting through the truss and is excluded as a different method for the same quantity. member_tension_compression_signs (batch sibling, position 4, not yet signed) owns the tension/compression sign CONVENTION and its cross-method consistency; this skill USES the convention - assume tension, a force pulling away from the joint, read a negative result as compression - and names the sibling as owner, a forward cession. zero_force_members (batch sibling, position 5) owns identification by INSPECTION rules; this skill computes member forces by equilibrium and does not teach those rules. Worked example Operator-re-derived from the on-disk prompt and independently recomputed: joints A(0,0) pin, D(4,0), C(8,0) roller, B(4,3); five members AB, AD, BD, BC, DC; loads 8 kN toward +x and 12 kN down at B, 6 kN down at D; reactions given Ax = 8 kN left, Ay = 6 kN up, Cy = 12 kN up. Unknown member forces before any solve: A has 2, B has 3, C has 2, D has 3. Joint A: SigmaFy 6 + 0.6 F_AB = 0 -> F_AB = -10 kN (10 kN COMPRESSION); SigmaFx -8 + 0.8(-10) + F_AD = 0 -> F_AD = +16 kN (TENSION). Propagation: with AD known, joint D drops to two unknowns - SigmaFy -6 + F_BD = 0 -> F_BD = +6 kN (TENSION); SigmaFx -16 + F_DC = 0 -> F_DC = +16 kN (TENSION). Joint C: SigmaFy 12 + 0.6 F_BC = 0 -> F_BC = -20 kN (20 kN COMPRESSION), with SigmaFx closing at -16 + (-0.8)(-20) = 0. Distinguishing feature bites: joints B and D each carry THREE unknown member forces so beginning there strands them against only two equations - the start-joint constraint is a real constraint, not a stated preference; joint D becomes tractable ONLY after joint A is solved, demonstrating propagation; tension and compression both appear so the sign convention carries meaning; no member force is zero, which would belong to the position-5 sibling; and F_AB = -10 against F_BC = -20 means the member forces are not symmetric, so a student cannot mirror rather than propagate. HONEST LIMITATION recorded: verifying at one unused joint checks ONLY the members meeting at that joint. VERIFICATION PRECEDES REPORT in both arrays, taken at joint B which was never used in the solve: AB contributes (8, 6), BD contributes (0, -6), BC contributes (-16, 12), loads (8, -12); SigmaFx = 0 and SigmaFy = 0, both closing. The artifact names AB, BD and BC as the members checked and states plainly that AD and DC do not meet at joint B and are not verified by it. FOUR-signal mapping, each a distinct authored act, with the triggers explicitly partitioned in a chain: solution_sequencing_error at step 2 (start-joint selection), sign_or_placement_error at step 3 (tension convention - its trigger opens by stipulating a valid start joint has been selected), axis_confusion at step 4 (member-axis component resolution - its trigger opens by stipulating the tension sense is correct), unclassified at step 7 (report and boundary). solution_sequencing_error is GENUINELY EARNED here and this is the first earn since wedge_friction: beginning at a joint carrying three unknown member forces writes two equilibrium equations against three unknowns, which are then mathematically underivable AT THAT JOINT rather than merely solved inefficiently, and the trigger keys on direct evidence of where the solve began, never inferred from a wrong final number. This contrasts with its correct omission across all five Batch 4I skills, where the component sums were independent and any order succeeded; the signal continues to be placed by error model rather than by recency or quota. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Trig-resolution cross-check N/A recorded affirmatively: member directions are given by joint coordinates and no inclined vector is decomposed from a stated angle. No archetype is asserted while PROCEDURE-ARCHETYPE-LIBRARY-V1 remains unapproved. Operator observation recorded, not corrected: this artifact declares SigmaFx and SigmaFy among its formula variables while truss_support_reactions declares M, x, y, Fx and Fy but not the summation symbols; both satisfy the declare-what-notation-uses floor and the difference is over-declaration rather than a gap, noted for a future normalisation pass. Review beat cleared at first pass; no correction lane. Unlocks zero_force_members.
